about: Games played on Protium and how they did. "macos/steamplay result" adds and changes entries, and the README's table is written from this file ("macos/steamplay games"). verdict: works, plays-with-problems, menu-only or broken.

games.name: IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator
games.note: Plays from its Steam library entry, with stats and cloud saves

games.name: GTFO
games.note: Starts, and its network layer and PlayFab sign-in come up. Matches untested

games.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.note: Reaches gameplay. Its frame rate is limited by CPU time

games.name: Call of Duty: World at War
games.note: Plays well; cutscenes can be skipped

games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered (2017)
games.note: Plays at 5120x1440 and 60 fps, mouse look even. The first load of a level takes several minutes while shaders compile

games.name: DOOM
games.note: Plays into its missions on Vulkan: set the launch option +r_renderAPI 1 and turn V-Sync off
